# VALIDITY: the per-row "valid" column is 1 iff every per-RUN load sample captured WHILE
# that specific gate was being measured stayed at or below load_threshold -- not merely at
# the start and end of the whole measurement pass. ALL_VALID below is the AND of every row's
# valid column and the final post-measurement guard. A false ALL_VALID does not stop this
# file from being written (a reader needs to see exactly which gates were affected)
# this script itself refuses to let a contaminated run silently overwrite an existing
# ALL_VALID=true artifact -- see mgc_write_with_overwrite_guard. Never trust a non-true
# ALL_VALID for a cost-class decision; regenerate once the host is idle instead.
